    <h1 class="devsite-page-title" tabindex="-1">
      Configure Gemini Code Assist code customization<devsite-actions hidden data-nosnippet><devsite-feature-tooltip

  <div class="devsite-article-body clearfix
  ">

  
    
    
    
    

<p>This document describes how to set up
<a href="/gemini/docs/codeassist/code-customization-overview">Gemini Code Assist code customization</a>
in the Google Cloud console, with the Google Cloud CLI, or with
Terraform by connecting Gemini Code Assist to your private code
repositories. Gemini Code Assist code customization feature lets
you receive code recommendations, which draw from the internal libraries,
private APIs, and coding style of your organization.</p>

<h2 id="before_you_begin" data-text="Before you begin" tabindex="-1">Before you begin</h2>

<ol>
<li><p><a href="/gemini/docs/codeassist/set-up-gemini">Set up Gemini Code Assist</a>
with an <a href="/gemini/docs/codeassist/overview#supported-features">Enterprise subscription</a>.</p></li>
<li><p>Verify that you have the following Identity and Access Management (IAM) roles on
the project that owns the subscription:</p>

<ul>
<li>Code Repository Indexes Admin (<code translate="no" dir="ltr">roles/cloudaicompanion.codeRepositoryIndexesAdmin</code>)</li>
<li>Gemini for Google Cloud User (<code translate="no" dir="ltr">roles/cloudaicompanion.user</code>)</li>
</ul></li>
<li><p>Create or configure user accounts. Every developer in your organization
who is using Gemini Code Assist must have a user identity in
Google Cloud that has permission to access your Google Cloud project.
For more information, see
<a href="/iam/docs/grant-role-console">Grant roles in the Google Cloud console</a>.
Verify each user has the following roles:</p>

<ul>
<li><a href="/iam/docs/roles-permissions/cloudaicompanion#cloudaicompanion.user">Gemini for Google Cloud User</a></li>
<li><a href="/iam/docs/roles-permissions/cloudaicompanion#cloudaicompanion.repositoryGroupsUser">Repository Groups User</a></li>
</ul></li>
<li><p>The code customization feature uses
<a href="/developer-connect/docs/overview">Developer Connect</a> to
access and index your private repositories. Ensure that the
Developer Connect region where your
Developer Connect repository connection is located is also a
supported location for code customization. The code customization
feature cannot be used if the Developer Connect connection is
in an unsupported region. For the list of supported regions, see
<a href="/gemini/docs/codeassist/code-customization-overview#limitations">code customization limitations</a>.</p></li>
</ol>

<h2 id="choose_which_repositories_are_indexed" data-text="Choose which repositories are indexed" tabindex="-1">Choose which repositories are indexed</h2>

<p>As a best practice, you should index repositories that have the following
characteristics:</p>

<ul>
<li>Code that&#39;s of a similar style or structure to what you want your
developers to write.</li>
<li>Private libraries or APIs that you would like to call from your current
codebase.</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="optional_choose_which_files_are_not_indexed" data-text="Optional: Choose which files are not indexed" tabindex="-1">Optional: Choose which files are not indexed</h2>

<p>By default, code customization indexes all the
<a href="/gemini/docs/codeassist/code-customization-overview#limitations">supported code files</a>
in your specified repositories.</p>

<p>To prevent exposure of code that you don&#39;t want to index, you can use branch
patterns to
<a href="/gemini/docs/codeassist/code-customization#configure-code-customization">control access to your index</a>
and use a stable branch, such as <code translate="no" dir="ltr">main</code>.</p>

<p>Alternatively, you can also exclude files from the index by
<a href="/gemini/docs/codeassist/create-aiexclude-file">creating an <code translate="no" dir="ltr">.aiexclude</code> file</a>.</p>

<h2 id="configure-code-customization" data-text="Configure Gemini Code Assist code customization" tabindex="-1">Configure Gemini Code Assist code customization</h2>

<p>Select one of the following options:</p>
<div><devsite-selector data-ds-scope="code-sample">
<section><h3 id="console" data-text=" Console " tabindex="-1"> Console </h3><ol>
<li><p>In the Google Cloud console, go to the <strong>Code Customization</strong> page.</p>

<p><a href="https://console.cloud.google.com/gemini-code-assist/code-customization?e=CodeAssistCodeCustomizationLaunch::CodeAssistCodeCustomizationEnabled&amp;invt=Ab537g&amp;mods=logs_tg_staging" target="console" class="button button-primary">Go to Code customization for Gemini Code Assist</a> </p>

<p>The <strong>Code customization for Gemini Code Assist</strong> page loads.</p></li>
<li><p>Create an index. Code customization relies on an index to analyze and parse
your repository for quicker code generation suggestions and lookups.</p>

<ol>
<li><p>Click <strong>Create</strong> and configure the index details:</p>

<ul>
<li>Select the region that is configured in
Developer Connect in your Google Cloud project.</li>
<li>Enter a name for your index. Note your index name. You need
it for several steps in this document.</li>
</ul></li>
<li><p>Click <strong>Create</strong>.</p></li>
</ol>

<p>Index creation generally takes 30 minutes to complete, but it might take
up to an hour. When indexing completes, you receive a notification in
the Google Cloud console.</p>

<p>Google limits the number of code repository indexes to one for each
project and organization.</p></li>
<li><p>Control access to your index using repository groups.</p>

<p>A repository group is a container for the indexing configuration, which
includes repositories and their branch patterns. Repository groups are
designed for granular IAM control, giving developers access
to the indexed data from those groups, where they have the
<code translate="no" dir="ltr">cloudaicompanion.repositoryGroups.use</code> permission.</p>

<p>Repository groups contain Developer Connect repositories,
or links, from the same project and location.</p></li>
<li><p>On the <strong>Code customization for Gemini Code Assist</strong> page, click
<strong>Add repositories</strong>, and then select <strong>Add source repositories</strong>.</p>

<p>A list displays of existing repositories in Developer Connect for
the region you configured in the previous step to create the index.</p>

<p>If you need to add new repositories to the repository group, then click
<strong>Link repository</strong> and follow the steps in the Google Cloud console.</p>

<p>Additionally, you can select and then edit one or more repositories to add
a new branch.</p></li>
<li><p>Select the repository group to which you want to add new repositories.
Alternatively, click <strong>Create a new repository group</strong> to create and
configure a new repository group.</p></li>
<li><p>To begin indexing the selected repositories, click <strong>Index</strong>.</p>

<p>Indexing time varies depending on the size of repositories.</p></li>
</ol></section>
<section><h3 id="cli" data-text=" CLI " tabindex="-1"> CLI </h3><ol>
<li>Verify that you have configured
<a href="/developer-connect/docs/overview">Developer Connect</a>
and connected to your repository:
<ul>
<li><a href="/developer-connect/docs/connect-github-repo">GitHub.com</a></li>
<li><a href="/developer-connect/docs/connect-gitlab">GitLab.com</a></li>
<li><a href="/developer-connect/docs/connect-bitbucket-cloud">Bitbucket.org</a></li>
</ul></li>
<li><p>In a shell environment, run the
<a href="/sdk/gcloud/reference/components/update"><code translate="no" dir="ltr">gcloud components update</code> command</a>
to verify that you have updated all installed components of the
<a href="/sdk/gcloud">gcloud CLI</a> to the latest version.
For this step, you can install and initialize the gcloud CLI, or
you can use <a href="/shell/docs">Cloud Shell Editor</a>.</p>
<div></div><devsite-code><pre class="devsite-click-to-copy" translate="no" dir="ltr" is-upgraded syntax="Bash"><code translate="no" dir="ltr">gcloud<span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span>components<span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span>update
</code></pre></devsite-code></li>
<li><p>Create an index. Code customization relies on an index to analyze and parse
your repository for quicker code generation suggestions and lookups.</p>

<ol>
<li><p>To create the index, in a shell environment, use the
<a href="/sdk/gcloud/reference/gemini/code-repository-indexes/create"><code translate="no" dir="ltr">gemini code-repository-indexes create</code> command</a>:</p>
<div></div><devsite-code><pre class="devsite-click-to-copy" translate="no" dir="ltr" is-upgraded><code translate="no" dir="ltr">gcloud gemini code-repository-indexes create <var translate="no">INDEX_NAME</var> \
    --project=<var translate="no">PROJECT_ID</var> \
    --location=<var translate="no">REGION</var>
</code></pre></devsite-code>
<p>Replace the following:</p>

<ul>
<li><code translate="no" dir="ltr"><var translate="no">INDEX_NAME</var></code>: your index name. <strong>Important</strong>:
Note your index name. You need it for several steps in this
document.</li>
<li><code translate="no" dir="ltr"><var translate="no">PROJECT_ID</var></code>: your Google Cloud project ID.</li>
<li><code translate="no" dir="ltr"><var translate="no">REGION</var></code>: the region that is configured in
Developer Connect in your Google Cloud project.
For commands to succeed, you must specify a
<a href="/gemini/docs/codeassist/code-customization-overview#limitations">supported region</a>.</li>
</ul>

<p>Index creation generally takes 30 minutes to complete, but it might take
up to an hour.</p>

<p>Google limits the number of code repository indexes to one for each
project and organization.</p></li>
</ol></li>
<li><p>Control access to your index using repository groups. A repository group is
a container for the indexing configuration, which includes repositories and
their branch patterns. Repository groups are designed for granular
IAM control, giving developers access to the indexed data
from those groups, where they have the
<code translate="no" dir="ltr">cloudaicompanion.repositoryGroups.use</code> permission.</p>

<p>Repository groups contain Developer Connect repositories, or
links, from the same project and location.</p>

<p>Administrators perform the following actions:</p>

<ul>
<li>Create the Code Repository Index resource.</li>
<li>In the same project and location, configure a new
Developer Connect connection.</li>
<li>Link Git repos in the connection.</li>
<li>Get links&#39; resource names, pick branch pattern to index for each
link, and put it to one or multiple repository groups.</li>
</ul>

<p>To create a repository group, in a shell environment, use the
<a href="/sdk/gcloud/reference/gemini/code-repository-indexes/repository-groups/create"><code translate="no" dir="ltr">gemini code-repository-indexes repository-groups create</code> command</a>:</p>
<div></div><devsite-code><pre class="devsite-click-to-copy" translate="no" dir="ltr" is-upgraded><code translate="no" dir="ltr">gcloud gemini code-repository-indexes repository-groups create <var translate="no">REPOSITORY_GROUP</var> \
    --project=<var translate="no">PROJECT_ID</var> \
    --location=<var translate="no">REGION</var> \
    --code-repository-index=<var translate="no">INDEX_NAME</var> \
    --repositories=&#39;[{&#34;resource&#34;: &#34;<var translate="no">REPOSITORY_RESOURCE_NAME</var>&#34;, &#34;branchPattern&#34;: &#34;<var translate="no">BRANCH_NAMES</var>&#34;}]&#39;
</code></pre></devsite-code><aside class="note"><strong>Note:</strong><span> You can use regular expression in
<a href="https://github.com/google/re2/wiki/syntax">RE2 syntax</a> to specify
branch names.</span></aside>
<p>Replace the following:</p>

<ul>
<li><code translate="no" dir="ltr"><var translate="no">REPOSITORY_GROUP</var></code>: name of the repository
group, such as <code translate="no" dir="ltr">default</code>.</li>
<li><code translate="no" dir="ltr"><var translate="no">REPOSITORY_RESOURCE_NAME</var></code>: name of the
repository inside the Developer Connect connection.
To find the name of the repository, go to the
<a href="https://console.cloud.google.com/developer-connect"><strong>Git repositories</strong> page</a>
in the Google Cloud console, and in the <strong>Repositories</strong> tab,
look for the Connection ID under the <strong>Connection</strong> column in the
table. To copy the resource name, click the

<span class="google-symbols">more_vert</span> menu for more options,
and select <strong>Copy resource path</strong>.</li>
<li><code translate="no" dir="ltr"><var translate="no">BRANCH_NAMES</var></code>: name of the branches you want
to index, such as <code translate="no" dir="ltr">main|dev</code>.</li>
</ul>

<p>You also can create a repository group with repositories defined in a
JSON (or YAML) file, formatted as follows:</p>
<div><devsite-selector data-ds-scope="code-sample">
<section><h3 id="json" data-text="JSON" tabindex="-1">JSON</h3><div></div><devsite-code><pre class="devsite-click-to-copy" translate="no" dir="ltr" is-upgraded syntax="JSON"><code translate="no" dir="ltr"><span class="devsite-syntax-p">[</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">  </span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">{</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">      </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nt">"resource"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">:</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"<var translate="no">REPOSITORY_RESOURCE_NAME</var>"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">,</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nt">"branchPattern"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">:</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"main|dev"</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">  </span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">},</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">  </span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">{</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">      </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nt">"resource"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">:</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"<var translate="no">REPOSITORY_RESOURCE_NAME</var>"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">,</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nt">"branchPattern"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">:</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"dev"</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">  </span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">}</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-p">]</span>
</code></pre></devsite-code></section>
<section><h3 id="yaml" data-text="YAML" tabindex="-1">YAML</h3><div></div><devsite-code><pre class="devsite-click-to-copy" translate="no" dir="ltr" is-upgraded syntax="YAML"><code translate="no" dir="ltr"><span class="devsite-syntax-p devsite-syntax-p-Indicator">-</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nt">resource</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">:</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><var translate="no"><span class="devsite-syntax-l devsite-syntax-l-Scalar devsite-syntax-l-Scalar-Plain">REPOSITORY_RESOURCE_NAME</span></var>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">  </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nt">branchPattern</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">:</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-l devsite-syntax-l-Scalar devsite-syntax-l-Scalar-Plain">main|dev</span>

<span class="devsite-syntax-p devsite-syntax-p-Indicator">-</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nt">resource</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">:</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><var translate="no"><span class="devsite-syntax-l devsite-syntax-l-Scalar devsite-syntax-l-Scalar-Plain">REPOSITORY_RESOURCE_NAME</span></var>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">  </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nt">branchPattern</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">:</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-l devsite-syntax-l-Scalar devsite-syntax-l-Scalar-Plain">dev</span>
</code></pre></devsite-code></section>
</devsite-selector></div>
<p>To create a repository group based on a JSON or YAML file, in a shell
environment, use the
<a href="/sdk/gcloud/reference/gemini/code-repository-indexes/repository-groups/create"><code translate="no" dir="ltr">gemini code-repository-indexes repository-groups create</code> command</a>:</p>
<div><devsite-selector data-ds-scope="code-sample">
<section><h3 id="json_1" data-text="JSON" tabindex="-1">JSON</h3><div></div><devsite-code><pre class="devsite-click-to-copy" translate="no" dir="ltr" is-upgraded syntax="Bash"><code translate="no" dir="ltr">gcloud<span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span>gemini<span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span>code-repository-indexes<span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span>repository-groups<span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span>create<span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><var translate="no">REPOSITORY_GROUP</var><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-se">\</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">    </span>--project<span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><var translate="no">PROJECT_ID</var><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-se">\</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">    </span>--location<span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><var translate="no">REGION</var><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-se">\</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">    </span>--code-repository-index<span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><var translate="no">INDEX_NAME</var><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-se">\</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">    </span>--repositories<span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><var translate="no">FILEPATH</var>.json
</code></pre></devsite-code></section>
<section><h3 id="yaml_1" data-text="YAML" tabindex="-1">YAML</h3><div></div><devsite-code><pre class="devsite-click-to-copy" translate="no" dir="ltr" is-upgraded syntax="Bash"><code translate="no" dir="ltr">gcloud<span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span>gemini<span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span>code-repository-indexes<span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span>repository-groups<span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span>create<span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><var translate="no">REPOSITORY_GROUP</var><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-se">\</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">    </span>--project<span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><var translate="no">PROJECT_ID</var><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-se">\</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">    </span>--location<span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><var translate="no">REGION</var><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-se">\</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">    </span>--code-repository-index<span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><var translate="no">INDEX_NAME</var><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-se">\</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">    </span>--repositories<span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><var translate="no">FILEPATH</var>.yaml
</code></pre></devsite-code></section>
</devsite-selector></div>
<p>If preferred, you can encrypt and control your data with a
customer-managed encryption key (CMEK) through
<a href="/kms/docs">Cloud Key Management Service</a>. To learn more about using a CMEK, see
<a href="/gemini/docs/codeassist/encrypt-data-cmek">Encrypt data with customer-managed encryption keys</a>.</p></li>
<li><p>Grant IAM roles to the repository group on a project.</p>

<p>You only receive suggestions from repositories in the index. Each
repository belongs to one or multiple repository groups. To access
suggestions, you must grant the Cloud AI Companion Repository Groups User
IAM role
(<code translate="no" dir="ltr">roles/cloudaicompanion.repositoryGroupsUser</code>)—which contains the
required <code translate="no" dir="ltr">cloudaicompanion.repositoryGroups.user</code> IAM
permission—to the repository group by one of the following ways:</p>
<ul>
<li>Grant principals permission to access the entire index.</li>
<li><p>Grant principals access to a subset of the index.</p></li>
</ul>
<div><devsite-selector data-ds-scope="code-sample">
<section><h3 id="entire-index" data-text="Entire index" tabindex="-1">Entire index</h3><ol>
<li><p>To bind an IAM policy for a project, in a shell
environment, use the
<a href="/sdk/gcloud/reference/projects/add-iam-policy-binding"><code translate="no" dir="ltr">projects add-iam-policy-binding</code> command</a>:</p>
<div></div><devsite-code><pre class="devsite-click-to-copy" translate="no" dir="ltr" is-upgraded syntax="Bash"><code translate="no" dir="ltr">gcloud<span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span>projects<span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span>add-iam-policy-binding<span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><var translate="no">PROJECT_ID</var><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-se">\</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">    </span>--member<span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-s1">'<var translate="no">PRINCIPAL</var>'</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-se">\</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">    </span>--role<span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-s1">'roles/cloudaicompanion.repositoryGroupsUser'</span>
</code></pre></devsite-code>
<p>Replace the following:</p>

<ul>
<li><code translate="no" dir="ltr"><var translate="no">PRINCIPAL</var></code>: the email address of the
principal that needs access—for example,
<code translate="no" dir="ltr">user:test-user@gmail.com</code> for an individual, or
<code translate="no" dir="ltr">group:admins@example.com</code> for a group.</li>
</ul>

<p>For more information, see
<a href="/sdk/gcloud/reference/projects/set-iam-policy"><code translate="no" dir="ltr">gcloud projects set-iam-policy</code></a>.</p></li>
<li><p>When prompted to specify a condition, enter <code translate="no" dir="ltr">None</code>.</p></li>
</ol></section>
<section><h3 id="subset-of-the-index" data-text="Subset of the index" tabindex="-1">Subset of the index</h3><p>You can create multiple repository groups and assign
IAM roles to different IAM principals.</p>

<p>In order to set up an IAM policy, you must prepare the
IAM policy JSON or YAML file, which will contain a
list of IAM groups and assigned roles. For example:</p>
<div></div><devsite-code><pre class="devsite-click-to-copy" translate="no" dir="ltr" is-upgraded><code translate="no" dir="ltr">  bindings:
  - members:
    - group:my-group@example.com
    - user:test-user@example.com
    role: roles/cloudaicompanion.repositoryGroupsUser
</code></pre></devsite-code>
<p>For additional details and syntax, see
<a href="/iam/docs/policies">Understanding allow policies</a>.</p>
<aside class="note"><strong>Note:</strong><span> You can assign custom roles to your IAM groups,
but the custom role must contain all permissions of the
<code translate="no" dir="ltr">roles/cloudaicompanion.repositoryGroupsUser</code> role.</span></aside>
<p>To set the IAM policy, in a shell environment, use
the
<a href="/sdk/gcloud/reference/gemini/code-repository-indexes/repository-groups/set-iam-policy"><code translate="no" dir="ltr">gemini code-repository-indexes repository-groups set-iam-policy</code> command</a>:</p>
<div></div><devsite-code><pre class="devsite-click-to-copy" translate="no" dir="ltr" is-upgraded><code translate="no" dir="ltr">  gcloud gemini code-repository-indexes repository-groups set-iam-policy <var translate="no">GROUP_NAME</var><var translate="no">POLICY_FILE</var> \
      --project=<var translate="no">PROJECT_ID</var> \
      --location=<var translate="no">REGION</var> \
      --code-repository-index=<var translate="no">INDEX_NAME</var>
</code></pre></devsite-code>
<p>Replace the following:</p>

<ul>
<li><code translate="no" dir="ltr"><var translate="no">GROUP_NAME</var></code>: the repository group name you
created in a preceding step to control access to your index using
repository groups.</li>
<li><p><code translate="no" dir="ltr"><var translate="no">POLICY_FILE</var></code>: the IAM policy.</p>

<p>For more information, see
<a href="/sdk/gcloud/reference/gemini/code-repository-indexes/repository-groups/set-iam-policy"><code translate="no" dir="ltr">gcloud gemini code-repository-indexes repository-groups set-iam-policy</code></a>.</p></li>
</ul></section>
</devsite-selector></div></li>
</ol></section>
<section><h3 id="terraform" data-text="Terraform" tabindex="-1">Terraform</h3><ol>
<li><p>Verify that you have configured
<a href="/developer-connect/docs/overview">Developer Connect</a>
and connected to your repository:</p>

<ul>
<li><a href="/developer-connect/docs/connect-github-repo">GitHub.com</a></li>
<li><a href="/developer-connect/docs/connect-gitlab">GitLab.com</a></li>
<li><a href="/developer-connect/docs/connect-bitbucket-cloud">Bitbucket.org</a></li>
</ul></li>
<li><p>Create an index. Code customization relies on an index to analyze and parse
your repository for quicker code generation suggestions and lookups.</p>
<div></div><devsite-code><pre class="devsite-click-to-copy" translate="no" dir="ltr" is-upgraded syntax="Terraform"><code translate="no" dir="ltr"><span class="devsite-syntax-kr">resource</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nc">"google_gemini_code_repository_index"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nv">"example"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">{</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">  </span><span class="devsite-syntax-na">location</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"<var translate="no">REGION</var>"</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">  </span><span class="devsite-syntax-na">code_repository_index_id</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"<var translate="no">INDEX_NAME</var>"</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-p">}</span>
</code></pre></devsite-code>
<p>Replace the following:</p>

<ul>
<li><code translate="no" dir="ltr"><var translate="no">INDEX_NAME</var></code>: your index name. <strong>Important</strong>:
Note your index name. You need it for several steps in this document.</li>
<li><code translate="no" dir="ltr"><var translate="no">PROJECT_ID</var></code>: your Google Cloud project ID.</li>
<li><code translate="no" dir="ltr"><var translate="no">REGION</var></code>: the region that is configured in
Developer Connect in your Google Cloud project.
For commands to succeed, you must specify a
<a href="/gemini/docs/codeassist/code-customization-overview#limitations">supported region</a>.</li>
</ul>

<p>Index creation generally takes 30 minutes to complete, but it might take
up to an hour.</p>

<p>Google limits the number of code repository indexes to one for each
project and organization.</p></li>
<li><p>Control access to your index using repository groups. A repository group
is a container for the indexing configuration, which includes repositories
and their branch patterns. Repository groups are designed for granular
IAM control, giving developers access to the indexed data
from those groups, where they have the
<code translate="no" dir="ltr">cloudaicompanion.repositoryGroups.use</code> permission.</p>

<p>Repository groups contain Developer Connect repositories,
or links, from the same project and location.</p>

<p>Administrators perform the following actions:</p>

<ul>
<li>Create Code the Repository Index resource.</li>
<li>In the same project and location, configure a new
Developer Connect connection.</li>
<li>Link Git repos in the connection.</li>
<li>Get links&#39; resource names, pick branch pattern to index for each link,
and put it to one or multiple repository groups.</li>
</ul>
<div></div><devsite-code><pre class="devsite-click-to-copy" translate="no" dir="ltr" is-upgraded syntax="Terraform"><code translate="no" dir="ltr"><span class="devsite-syntax-kr">resource</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nc">"google_gemini_repository_group"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nv">"example"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">{</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">  </span><span class="devsite-syntax-na">location</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"<var translate="no">REGION</var>"</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">  </span><span class="devsite-syntax-na">code_repository_index</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"<var translate="no">INDEX_NAME</var>"</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">  </span><span class="devsite-syntax-na">repository_group_id</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"<var translate="no">REPOSITORY_GROUP</var>"</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">  </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nb">repositories</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">{</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">    </span><span class="devsite-syntax-na">resource</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"<var translate="no">REPOSITORY_RESOURCE_NAME</var>"</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">    </span><span class="devsite-syntax-na">branch_pattern</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"<var translate="no">BRANCH_NAMES</var>"</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">  </span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">}</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-p">}</span>
</code></pre></devsite-code><aside class="note"><strong>Note:</strong><span> You can use regular expression in
<a href="https://github.com/google/re2/wiki/syntax">RE2 syntax</a> to specify branch
names.</span></aside>
<p>Replace the following:</p>

<ul>
<li><code translate="no" dir="ltr"><var translate="no">REPOSITORY_GROUP</var></code>: name of the repository group,
such as <code translate="no" dir="ltr">default</code>.</li>
<li><code translate="no" dir="ltr"><var translate="no">REPOSITORY_RESOURCE_NAME</var></code>: name of the repository
inside the Developer Connect connection. To find the name
of the repository, go to the
<a href="https://console.cloud.google.com/developer-connect"><strong>Git repositories</strong> page</a>
in the Google Cloud console, and in the <strong>Repositories</strong> tab, look
for the Connection ID under the <strong>Connection</strong> column in the table. To
copy the resource name, click the

<span class="google-symbols">more_vert</span> menu for more options, and
select <strong>Copy resource path</strong>.</li>
<li><code translate="no" dir="ltr"><var translate="no">BRANCH_NAMES</var></code>: name of the branches you want to
index, such as <code translate="no" dir="ltr">main|dev</code>.</li>
</ul>

<p>You also can create a repository group with repositories defined in a JSON
(or YAML) file, formatted as follows:</p>
<div><devsite-selector data-ds-scope="code-sample">
<section><h3 id="json_2" data-text="JSON" tabindex="-1">JSON</h3><div></div><devsite-code><pre class="devsite-click-to-copy" translate="no" dir="ltr" is-upgraded syntax="JSON"><code translate="no" dir="ltr"><span class="devsite-syntax-p">[</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">  </span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">{</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">      </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nt">"resource"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">:</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"<var translate="no">REPOSITORY_RESOURCE_NAME</var>"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">,</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nt">"branchPattern"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">:</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"main|dev"</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">  </span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">},</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">  </span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">{</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">      </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nt">"resource"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">:</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"<var translate="no">REPOSITORY_RESOURCE_NAME</var>"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">,</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nt">"branchPattern"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">:</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"dev"</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">  </span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">}</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-p">]</span>
</code></pre></devsite-code></section>
<section><h3 id="yaml_2" data-text="YAML" tabindex="-1">YAML</h3><div></div><devsite-code><pre class="devsite-click-to-copy" translate="no" dir="ltr" is-upgraded syntax="YAML"><code translate="no" dir="ltr"><span class="devsite-syntax-p devsite-syntax-p-Indicator">-</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nt">resource</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">:</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><var translate="no"><span class="devsite-syntax-l devsite-syntax-l-Scalar devsite-syntax-l-Scalar-Plain">REPOSITORY_RESOURCE_NAME</span></var>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">  </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nt">branchPattern</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">:</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-l devsite-syntax-l-Scalar devsite-syntax-l-Scalar-Plain">main|dev</span>

<span class="devsite-syntax-p devsite-syntax-p-Indicator">-</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nt">resource</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">:</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><var translate="no"><span class="devsite-syntax-l devsite-syntax-l-Scalar devsite-syntax-l-Scalar-Plain">REPOSITORY_RESOURCE_NAME</span></var>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">  </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nt">branchPattern</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">:</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-l devsite-syntax-l-Scalar devsite-syntax-l-Scalar-Plain">dev</span>
</code></pre></devsite-code></section>
</devsite-selector></div>
<p>To create a repository group based on a JSON or YAML file, in a shell
environment, use the
<a href="/sdk/gcloud/reference/gemini/code-repository-indexes/repository-groups/create"><code translate="no" dir="ltr">gemini code-repository-indexes repository-groups create</code> command</a>:</p>
<div><devsite-selector data-ds-scope="code-sample">
<section><h3 id="json_3" data-text="JSON" tabindex="-1">JSON</h3><div></div><devsite-code><pre class="devsite-click-to-copy" translate="no" dir="ltr" is-upgraded syntax="Bash"><code translate="no" dir="ltr">gcloud<span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span>gemini<span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span>code-repository-indexes<span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span>repository-groups<span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span>create<span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><var translate="no">REPOSITORY_GROUP</var><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-se">\</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">    </span>--project<span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><var translate="no">PROJECT_ID</var><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-se">\</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">    </span>--location<span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><var translate="no">REGION</var><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-se">\</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">    </span>--code-repository-index<span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><var translate="no">INDEX_NAME</var><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-se">\</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">    </span>--repositories<span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><var translate="no">FILEPATH</var>.json
</code></pre></devsite-code></section>
<section><h3 id="yaml_3" data-text="YAML" tabindex="-1">YAML</h3><div></div><devsite-code><pre class="devsite-click-to-copy" translate="no" dir="ltr" is-upgraded syntax="Bash"><code translate="no" dir="ltr">gcloud<span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span>gemini<span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span>code-repository-indexes<span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span>repository-groups<span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span>create<span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><var translate="no">REPOSITORY_GROUP</var><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-se">\</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">    </span>--project<span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><var translate="no">PROJECT_ID</var><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-se">\</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">    </span>--location<span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><var translate="no">REGION</var><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-se">\</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">    </span>--code-repository-index<span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><var translate="no">INDEX_NAME</var><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-se">\</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">    </span>--repositories<span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><var translate="no">FILEPATH</var>.yaml
</code></pre></devsite-code></section>
</devsite-selector></div>
<p>If preferred, you can encrypt and control your data with a
customer-managed encryption key (CMEK) through
<a href="/kms/docs">Cloud Key Management Service</a>. To learn more about using a CMEK, see
<a href="/gemini/docs/codeassist/encrypt-data-cmek">Encrypt data with customer-managed encryption keys</a>.</p></li>
<li><p>Grant IAM roles to the repository group on a project.</p>

<p>You only receive suggestions from repositories in the index. Each
repository belongs to one or multiple repository groups. To access
suggestions, you must grant the Cloud AI Companion Repository Groups User
IAM role
(<code translate="no" dir="ltr">roles/cloudaicompanion.repositoryGroupsUser</code>)—which contains the
required <code translate="no" dir="ltr">cloudaicompanion.repositoryGroups.user</code> IAM
permission—to the repository group by one of the following ways:</p>
<ul>
<li>Grant principals permission to access the entire index.</li>
<li><p>Grant principals access to a subset of the index.</p></li>
</ul>
<div><devsite-selector data-ds-scope="code-sample">
<section><h3 id="entire-index_1" data-text="Entire index" tabindex="-1">Entire index</h3><ol>
<li><p>To bind an IAM policy for a project, in a shell
environment, use the
<a href="/sdk/gcloud/reference/projects/add-iam-policy-binding"><code translate="no" dir="ltr">projects add-iam-policy-binding</code> command</a>:</p>
<div></div><devsite-code><pre class="devsite-click-to-copy" translate="no" dir="ltr" is-upgraded syntax="Bash"><code translate="no" dir="ltr">gcloud<span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span>projects<span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span>add-iam-policy-binding<span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><var translate="no">PROJECT_ID</var><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-se">\</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">    </span>--member<span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-s1">'<var translate="no">PRINCIPAL</var>'</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-se">\</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">    </span>--role<span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-s1">'roles/cloudaicompanion.repositoryGroupsUser'</span>
</code></pre></devsite-code>
<p>Replace the following:</p>

<ul>
<li><p><code translate="no" dir="ltr"><var translate="no">PRINCIPAL</var></code>: the email address of the
principal that needs access—for example,
<code translate="no" dir="ltr">user:test-user@gmail.com</code> for an individual, or
<code translate="no" dir="ltr">group:admins@example.com</code> for a group.</p>

<p>For more information, see
<a href="/sdk/gcloud/reference/projects/set-iam-policy"><code translate="no" dir="ltr">gcloud projects set-iam-policy</code></a>.</p></li>
</ul></li>
<li><p>When prompted to specify a condition, enter <code translate="no" dir="ltr">None</code>.</p></li>
</ol></section>
<section><h3 id="subset-of-the-index_1" data-text="Subset of the index" tabindex="-1">Subset of the index</h3><p>You can create multiple repository groups and assign
IAM roles to different IAM principals.</p>
<div></div><devsite-code><pre class="devsite-click-to-copy" translate="no" dir="ltr" is-upgraded syntax="Terraform"><code translate="no" dir="ltr"><span class="devsite-syntax-w">  </span><span class="devsite-syntax-kr">data</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nc">"google_iam_policy"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nv">"foo"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">{</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">    </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nb">binding</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">{</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">      </span><span class="devsite-syntax-na">role</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"roles/cloudaicompanion.repositoryGroupsUser"</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">      </span><span class="devsite-syntax-na">members</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">[</span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"test-user@example.com"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">]</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">    </span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">}</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">  </span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">}</span>

<span class="devsite-syntax-w">  </span><span class="devsite-syntax-kr">resource</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nc">"google_gemini_repository_group_iam_policy"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nv">"foo"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">{</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">    </span><span class="devsite-syntax-na">project</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"<var translate="no">PROJECT_ID</var>"</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">    </span><span class="devsite-syntax-na">location</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"<var translate="no">REGION</var>"</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">    </span><span class="devsite-syntax-na">code_repository_index_id</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"<var translate="no">INDEX_NAME</var>"</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">    </span><span class="devsite-syntax-na">repository_group_id</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"<var translate="no">GROUP_NAME</var>"</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">    </span><span class="devsite-syntax-na">policy_data</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nv">data.google_iam_policy.foo.policy_data</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">  </span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">}</span>

<span class="devsite-syntax-w">  </span><span class="devsite-syntax-kr">data</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nc">"google_gemini_repository_group_iam_policy"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nv">"foo"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">{</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">    </span><span class="devsite-syntax-na">project</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"<var translate="no">PROJECT_ID</var>"</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">    </span><span class="devsite-syntax-na">location</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"<var translate="no">REGION</var>"</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">    </span><span class="devsite-syntax-na">code_repository_index_id</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"<var translate="no">INDEX_NAME</var>"</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">    </span><span class="devsite-syntax-na">repository_group_id</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"<var translate="no">GROUP_NAME</var>"</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">    </span><span class="devsite-syntax-na">depends_on</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">[</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">      </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nv">google_gemini_repository_group_iam_policy.foo</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">    </span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">]</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">  </span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">}</span>
</code></pre></devsite-code>
<p>You can also create a binding:</p>
<div></div><devsite-code><pre class="devsite-click-to-copy" translate="no" dir="ltr" is-upgraded syntax="Terraform"><code translate="no" dir="ltr"><span class="devsite-syntax-w">  </span><span class="devsite-syntax-kr">resource</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nc">"google_gemini_repository_group_iam_binding"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nv">"foo"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">{</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">    </span><span class="devsite-syntax-na">project</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"<var translate="no">PROJECT_ID</var>"</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">    </span><span class="devsite-syntax-na">location</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"<var translate="no">REGION</var>"</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">    </span><span class="devsite-syntax-na">code_repository_index_id</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"<var translate="no">INDEX_NAME</var>"</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">    </span><span class="devsite-syntax-na">repository_group_id</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"<var translate="no">GROUP_NAME</var>"</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">    </span><span class="devsite-syntax-na">role</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"roles/cloudaicompanion.repositoryGroupsUser"</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">    </span><span class="devsite-syntax-na">members</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">[</span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"test-user@example.com"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">]</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">  </span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">}</span>
</code></pre></devsite-code>
<p>Replace the following:</p>

<ul>
<li><code translate="no" dir="ltr"><var translate="no">GROUP_NAME</var></code>: the repository group name
you created in a preceding step to control access to your index
using repository groups.</li>
</ul></section>
</devsite-selector></div></li>
</ol></section>
</devsite-selector></div>
<h2 id="check_indexing_status" data-text="Check indexing status" tabindex="-1">Check indexing status</h2>

<p>Depending on the number of repositories you want to index and their
size, indexing content can take up to 24 hours. For large repositories, indexing
can take longer. Indexing occurs once every 24 hours, picking up any changes
that were made in the repository.</p>
<ol>
<li><p>Search for the <code translate="no" dir="ltr">indexing</code> logs. For more information, see
<a href="/logging/docs/view/logging-query-language">Logging query language</a>.</p>
<div><devsite-selector data-ds-scope="code-sample">
<section><h3 id="console_1" data-text=" Console " tabindex="-1"> Console </h3><ol>
<li><p>In the Google Cloud console, go to the
<a href="/logging/docs/view/logs-explorer-interface"><strong>Logs Explorer</strong></a>.</p>

<p><a href="https://console.cloud.google.com/logs/query" target="console" class="button button-primary">Go to Logs Explorer</a> </p></li>
<li><p>Use the log names filter to view <code translate="no" dir="ltr">indexing</code> logs.</p></li>
</ol></section>
<section><h3 id="cli_1" data-text=" CLI " tabindex="-1"> CLI </h3><p>To search for the indexing logs, in a shell environment, use the
<a href="/sdk/gcloud/reference/logging/read"><code translate="no" dir="ltr">logging read</code> command</a>:</p>
<div></div><devsite-code><pre class="devsite-click-to-copy" translate="no" dir="ltr" is-upgraded><code translate="no" dir="ltr">gcloud logging read &#34;logName=&#34;projects/<var translate="no">PROJECT_ID</var>/logs/indexing&#34;&#34;
</code></pre></devsite-code>
<p>Replace <code translate="no" dir="ltr"><var translate="no">PROJECT_ID</var></code> with the project ID where
the repository group is located.</p>

<p>For example, to view errors in the <code translate="no" dir="ltr">indexing</code> logs, run the following
command:</p>
<div></div><devsite-code><pre class="devsite-click-to-copy" translate="no" dir="ltr" is-upgraded><code translate="no" dir="ltr">gcloud logging read &#34;logName=&#34;projects/<var translate="no">PROJECT_ID</var>/logs/indexing&#34; AND severity&gt;=ERROR&#34;
</code></pre></devsite-code></section>
</devsite-selector></div></li>
<li><p>Review the associated indexing statuses, such as the following:</p>

<ul>
<li>Start of repository indexing-for example, <code translate="no" dir="ltr">Indexing repository <var translate="no">REPOSITORY_NAME</var>. Total number of repositories: 10, succeeded: 6, failed: 0.</code></li>
<li>End of individual repository indexing-for example:
<ul>
<li>Success: <code translate="no" dir="ltr">Successfully finished indexing repository <var translate="no">REPOSITORY_NAME</var>. Total number of repositories: 10, succeeded: 7, failed: 0.</code></li>
<li>Failure: <code translate="no" dir="ltr">Failed to index repository <var translate="no">REPOSITORY_NAME</var>. Error: [&lt;error message&gt;]. Total number of repositories: 10, succeeded: 7, failed: 1.</code></li>
</ul></li>
<li>End of repository indexing-for example:
<ul>
<li>Success: <code translate="no" dir="ltr">Finished indexing process. Repositories attempted: 10. Repositories successfully indexed: 9. Repositories unsuccessfully fetched: 0.</code></li>
<li>Failure: <code translate="no" dir="ltr">Finished indexing process. Repositories attempted: 10. Repositories successfully indexed: 9. Repositories unsuccessfully fetched: 1. Repositories that were not successfully fetched will be retried in the next run.</code></li>
</ul></li>
</ul>

<p>In the index statuses, <code translate="no" dir="ltr"><var translate="no">REPOSITORY_NAME</var></code> is the repository
you want to review.</p></li>
<li><p>Review the associated indexing errors, such as the following:</p>

<ul>
<li>Failed to fetch repository.</li>
<li>Failed to list repository files.</li>
<li>Failed to retrieve repository information from the index.</li>
<li>Failed to retrieve files from the index.</li>
<li>Internal error.</li>
</ul></li>
</ol>
<h2 id="use-code-customization" data-text="Use code customization" tabindex="-1">Use code customization</h2>

<p>Once you have set up code customization, you&#39;ll begin to see code completion
and code generation suggestions which may be based on private code you have
indexed in addition to results from full codebase awareness.</p>

<p>Developers added to the repository group where at least one resource is indexed
will receive a notice in their IDE that code customization was enabled. To see
the code customization status, developers can click the
<span class="google-symbols" translate="no">spark</span> <strong>Gemini</strong> symbol in
the bottom right corner and look for one of the following code customization
statuses in the search bar:</p>

<ul>
<li><strong>All set</strong>. Code customization is enabled and configured.</li>
<li><strong>Unavailable</strong>. The developer is missing repository group access or the
repository group to which the user has access is empty.</li>
<li><strong>Unset</strong>. Code customization either isn&#39;t enabled or isn&#39;t configured by the
administrator.</li>
</ul>

<p>To learn more about using code customization and best practices, see
<a href="/gemini/docs/codeassist/use-code-customization">Use code customization</a>.</p>

<h2 id="turn-off-code-customization" data-text="Turn off code customization" tabindex="-1">Turn off code customization</h2>

<p>Select one of the following options:</p>
<div><devsite-selector data-ds-scope="code-sample">
<section><h3 id="console_2" data-text=" Console " tabindex="-1"> Console </h3><ol>
<li><p>In the Google Cloud console, go to the <strong>Gemini Products</strong> page.</p>

<p><a href="https://console.cloud.google.com/gemini-admin" target="console" class="button button-primary">Go to Gemini Products</a> </p>

<p>The <strong>Gemini Products</strong> page loads.</p></li>
<li><p>In the navigation menu, click <strong>Code customization</strong>.</p>

<p>The <strong>Code customization</strong> page loads.</p></li>
<li><p>To delete the index, click <strong>Delete</strong>.</p>

<p>A warning message is displayed. If you want to proceed and delete the
index, enter the index name, and then click <strong>Delete</strong>.</p></li>
</ol></section>
<section><h3 id="cli_2" data-text=" CLI " tabindex="-1"> CLI </h3><ol>
<li><p>To list all repository groups for the current index, in a shell
environment, use the
<a href="/sdk/gcloud/reference/gemini/code-repository-indexes/repository-groups/list"><code translate="no" dir="ltr">gemini code-repository-indexes repository-groups list</code> command</a>:</p>
<div></div><devsite-code><pre class="devsite-click-to-copy" translate="no" dir="ltr" is-upgraded><code translate="no" dir="ltr">gcloud gemini code-repository-indexes repository-groups list --location=<var translate="no">REGION</var> \
    --project=<var translate="no">PROJECT_ID</var> \
    --code-repository-index=<var translate="no">INDEX_NAME</var> --uri
</code></pre></devsite-code>
<p>Replace the following:</p>

<ul>
<li><code translate="no" dir="ltr"><var translate="no">REGION</var></code>: the region that is configured in
Developer Connect in your Google Cloud project.
For commands to succeed, you must specify a
<a href="/gemini/docs/codeassist/code-customization-overview#limitations">supported region</a>.</li>
<li><code translate="no" dir="ltr"><var translate="no">PROJECT_ID</var></code>: your Google Cloud project ID.</li>
<li><code translate="no" dir="ltr"><var translate="no">INDEX_NAME</var></code>: name of the index you created in a
preceding step to create an index.</li>
</ul></li>
<li><p>To delete a repository group from the current index, use the
<a href="/sdk/gcloud/reference/gemini/code-repository-indexes/repository-groups/list"><code translate="no" dir="ltr">gemini code-repository-indexes repository-groups delete</code> command</a>:</p>
<div></div><devsite-code><pre class="devsite-click-to-copy" translate="no" dir="ltr" is-upgraded><code translate="no" dir="ltr">gcloud gemini code-repository-indexes repository-groups delete <var translate="no">REPOSITORY_GROUP</var> \
    --location=<var translate="no">REGION</var> \
    --project=<var translate="no">PROJECT_ID</var> \
    --code-repository-index=<var translate="no">INDEX_NAME</var>
</code></pre></devsite-code></li>
<li><p>Repeat the preceding steps for each repository group until you delete all
repository groups from the index.</p></li>
<li><p>Optional: To delete the index, in a shell environment, use the
<a href="/sdk/gcloud/reference/gemini/code-repository-indexes/delete"><code translate="no" dir="ltr">gemini code-repository-indexes delete</code> command</a>:</p>
<div></div><devsite-code><pre class="devsite-click-to-copy" translate="no" dir="ltr" is-upgraded><code translate="no" dir="ltr">gcloud gemini code-repository-indexes delete <var translate="no">INDEX_NAME</var> \
    --location=<var translate="no">REGION</var> \
    --project=<var translate="no">PROJECT_ID</var>
</code></pre></devsite-code></li>
</ol></section>
</devsite-selector></div>
<h2 id="whats_next" data-text="What's next" tabindex="-1">What's next</h2>

<ul>
<li>Start using Gemini Code Assist:
<ul>
<li>VS Code, IntelliJ, and other supported JetBrains IDEs: <a href="/gemini/docs/codeassist/write-code-gemini">Code with Gemini Code Assist</a></li>
<li>Cloud Shell Editor: <a href="/code/docs/shell/write-code-gemini">Code with Gemini Code Assist</a></li>
<li>Cloud Workstations: <a href="/workstations/docs/write-code-gemini">Code with Gemini Code Assist</a></li>
</ul></li>
<li>Learn how to <a href="/gemini/docs/codeassist/use-code-customization">use code customization</a>
and best practices.</li>
<li>Learn how to <a href="/gemini/docs/codeassist/encrypt-data-cmek">encrypt data with customer-managed encryption keys (CMEK)</a>.</li>
<li>Learn more about <a href="/developer-connect/docs/overview">Developer Connect</a>.</li>
<li>Learn <a href="/gemini/docs/discover/data-governance">how and when Gemini Code Assist uses your data</a>.</li>
</ul>
